head_commit.message:
Merge origin/dev into T-2388 blockhouse cupola

dev moved under this branch while the family was being rebuilt (T-2383, T-3360,
T-3361, T-3353 and two changelog folds). Conflicts, and how each was taken:

  docs/LIBERTIES.md, docs/ROADMAP.md, docs/STATUS.md — both sides APPEND. dev's
  file taken whole and this branch's appended block re-applied after it, so no
  concurrent suffix is replaced.

  data/liberties.json, data/sidecars/1835/sources/index.json,
  docs/measurements/source_use_coverage.md — GENERATED. dev's taken, then
  rebuilt from the merged tree with tools/compile_liberties.py,
  tools/compile_source_use.py and tools/compile_scene.py --all, so the products
  are derived from both sides rather than picked from one.

No geometry, no record and no manifest row was resolved by hand. The smoke
readings this run filed are carried in tools/dev-smoke-state.json.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
